integrity: The facet set is reconstructed from the published defining formula. Exact mod-two linear algebra and exhaustive enumeration cover all 65,536 one-cocycles; the packaged verifier checks every stated numerical and support claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact computation for the single published triangulation Q_{5,3}; no all-parameter claim for Q_{2m+1,n}. Literature search cannot exclude every obscure or unindexed equivalent computation.
title: The two exceptional five-vertex blocks of \(Q_{5,3}\) are its unique square-nonzero cosystolic carriers
